protocol.method: Circular calendar blocks sampled independently WITHIN each transfer window; preserve each window original day count, keep all sleeves/candidate/cost scenarios paired on the same day. Pool daily means weighted by observation days; no NAV chaining or gap filling. Percentile95% intervals for selected absolute base/stress means and paired selected-minus-baseline differences. Both7 and28day intervals reported, never chosen after results. Completed-trade netR and dollar expectation descriptive, not iid confidence. Leave-one-symbol-out summaries diagnostic only, never a symbol selector.
protocol.acceptance: Historical positive-expectancy candidate for forward observation only if development qualification passes; >=180 transfer days, >=100 trades and>=10 per symbol under each cost scenario; both transfer windows have positive net returns at base and stress, each daily portfolio drawdown >=-10%; absolute selected daily-mean lower95%bound >0 for BOTH7/28day blocks under base and stress. Paired improvement reported separately and does not substitute for absolute profitability. If points positive but intervals crosszero, status remains not-established. A failed criterion forbids promotion/reselection this round. Passing still does not establish future profitability or warrant automatic live deployment.

leaveOneSymbolOut.scope: Descriptive account daily means after omitting one original fixed sleeve; no capital redistribution, rerun, selection, or acceptance criterion.

acceptance.meaning: Historical transfer evidence only; no guarantee of future profitability, reselection, or automatic deployment.

conventions.bootstrapPairing: same within-window date indices for all sleeves, candidates and costs
conventions.interval: 95% percentile, sorted ranks floor(samples*.025) and floor(samples*.975)

limitations: Retrospective historical transfer, not prospective or live evidence.
No cross-window blocks, gap filling or chained NAV. Longer windows receive proportionally more weight.
Intervals describe the frozen choice; they do not correct all earlier adaptive research trials or prove stationarity.
Trade net-R and dollar expectancy are ledger descriptions, not independent-trade inference. Paired improvement cannot replace absolute profitability.

selection.criterion: Select exactly once on development base-cost daily portfolio Sharpe from the declared six-candidate pool, subject to >=30 completed trades per symbol and finite Sharpe. Ties follow candidate declaration order (baseline first). Stop without inspecting transfer outcomes if none qualify. Do not re-rank after the separate >=4 profitable symbols and positive median-symbol-mean-R qualification; still test the frozen choice, report any qualification failure. N160/N640 are diagnostic only and permanently excluded from selection.
